messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed several tenants got sudden quota bursts after we started the soft v2 handoff. Looks tied to route pinning + autoswitch fallthrough.

Tomas: do you have a repro? specific tenant or route?

maria: tenant=acme-marketing. Their traffic pattern has lots of short seq/low-token requests but pinning kept them on v1 for a while, then a tiny header mismatch triggered a fallback to v2 and quota doubled for the same logical requests.

Sophie: hmm, is this the old case where pinning TTL and header-negotiation debounce race each other?

maria: yes. TTL=24h pin + handshake debounce=5m. On a burst the client header flips -> autoswitch kicks -> console shows both variants counted.

Jason: console currently attributes tokens to the route variant that served the request, so if we flip mid-session we end up charging both v1 and v2 metrics in the same user journey.

ops-bot: deploy started: routing-proxy v3.14 -> canary on eu-west-1 (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:

maria: not the deploy cause — repro predates canary. But the deploy might make telemetry noisier.

eng-platform-bot: alert: route-pinning-ttl-debounce errors increased by 18% over last 6h.

Tomas: proposal: add an "escape hatch" flag on the console that forces immediate unpin for a tenant, plus a short-lived pin-grace window on the routing plane that prevents double-attribution during active handshakes. Thoughts?

Sophie: two questions: (1) what should the grace window be? (2) how visible in the console? we need to avoid accidental quota loopholes.

Jason: For (1) I'd target 2 minutes by default, configurable per-tenant. Low enough to avoid prolonged mismatches but long enough to cover handshake jitter.

maria: (2) Console view: show a stacked column for tokens: pinned-variant, fallback-variant, and overlap. And add an annotation in time-series when escape-hatch toggled.

Sophie: we also need telemetry split: separate counters for "served-variant" vs "billing-variant" until we can converge. That way billing decisions can be deterministic while health metrics show actual traffic.

Tomas: Agree. Implementation plan:
- routing proxy: implement transient pin-grace state (2m default) keyed to route hash
- control plane: escape-hatch toggle for tenant (forces unpin + emits audit event)
- billing pipeline: conservative default = charge only the stable (pre-pin) variant unless explicit unpin audit present
- console: add overlap series + action button

maria: Example CLI to force-unpin we discussed:
```
redwood route unpin --tenant acme-marketing --force --reason "quota spike investigation"
```
Will emit audit: route.unpin.force

Jason: telemetry events we should add: route.pin.requested, route.pin.forced, route.pin.expired, route.pin.grace-enter, route.pin.grace-leave, route.attribute.overlap_detected. Keep them lightweight.

Sophie: Sampling: we can't emit all overlap_detected events at 100% for large tenants. Suggest 1% global sample + deterministic 100% for tenants in trial or where escape hatch used.

maria: UX: in the console rollout page show a small badge on tenants currently in pin-grace. Hover shows the last 10 events (unpin/forced/overlap). Also expose API to pull overlap windows for audit.

Tomas: backward-compat note: some client libraries send legacy header x-redwood-version and others send version=auto. We must treat a header flip from legacy->auto as handshake jitter, not a hard migration. Grace window covers this.

Jason: one potential issue: if billing pipeline changes charge semantics, legal needs to review. I'll loop in finance/compliance once we have default decision (charge stable vs charge served).

Sophie: action items:
- @maria: draft console mock for overlap visualization (WIP)
- @tomas: PR for transient pin-grace in routing proxy (target: canary next week)
- @jason: telemetry schema PR + billing delta spec (add to billing backlog)
- ops: make sure deploys don't toggle sampling config during canary window

maria: I'll add the mock to the design board and ping infra for quota query endpoints.

eng-platform-bot: note: canary scheduled for routing-proxy v3.14 in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-23T02:00Z

Tomas: one more: add a read-only console flag "simulate-unpin" that shows hypothetical token attribution if unpin applied without changing state. Helps support preview.

Jason: +1 for simulate-unpin. low risk. We'll wire it to billing-sim only (no effect on real billing).

Sophie: ok. I'll start the console tickets and add an acceptance test for overlap-series rendering.

maria: thanks team. If we see more tenants, escalate to infra for a temporary global grace toggle.

Jason: noted. I'll draft the billing/compliance note today and share.

maria: closing: filing incident follow-up ticket with root cause notes and the proposed plan. Will link PRs here when available. :memo:
